items.title: Bring data quality to your Amazon EMR workloads with Amazon EMR Data Quality built on AWS Glue Data Quality
items.summary: AWS Glue Data Quality is now available natively on Amazon EMR, bundled in AWS runtime for Apache Spark (emr-spark-8.1.0). Write the same DQDL rulesets you use in AWS Glue directly in your Amazon EMR Spark jobs. This post walks through two patterns: lightweight inline validation and an Apache Iceberg Write-Audit-Publish workflow with managed rulesets.
items.creator: Mert Hocanin
